reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is unchanged with no counterparty comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited text supports compliance: p0543's 'not less favorable in any material respect to SFJ' is a benchmark for a replacement lender's subordination agreement against the SVB subordination agreement, not an obligation on PB (our party) to extend SFJ any better terms granted to third parties, so it is not an MFN within the rule's detection guidance.

p0552 imposes consent/approval mechanics on PB's Licensing Transactions (with Excluded Licensing Transaction carve-outs), not a best-terms or price-matching obligation; noting this in the rationale rather than flagging it is correct and also avoids double-flagging an assignment/licensing-control term.
No MFN obligation burdening the Customer exists, which matches the preferred position; the rule's fallback and walk-away tests are not triggered, so no actionable redline is required.
